dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic construction licences issued by mivhed 2022 2026

description: Ministerio de la Vivienda, Hábitat y Edificaciones (MIVHED), Dominican Republic publishes the construction licences issued by the housing ministry from 2022 to 2026, organised by issue date, month, year, province, municipality, neighbourhood, permit number, typology, square metres and total investment. Coverage: the Dominican Republic, by province, municipality and neighbourhood; 2022 to 2026, updated quarterly, record last modified on 2026-07-21. Format and access: XLSX, CSV, ODS, JSON, downloadable without registration from the Dominican open data portal (datos.gob.do); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened; it records licences issued, not buildings completed, and the typology classes are as defined by the ministry. Simulation uses: construction-activity and new-floor-area inputs for building-stock growth and housing-supply models, and exposure growth in hazard-prone provinces. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
